annotations.title: Save a video as a preset

description: SAVE A FINISHED VIDEO AS A REUSABLE PRESET: its beat structure, pacing, look, captions, how the words are delivered and its sound are read off it once and kept with the video, so new videos can be made in the same style (make_from_preset). Takes a render, a Library video, a file link, or a TikTok / Reel / Facebook / X post link. About 2 credits (one watch). Optional: name, the saved creator who stars in videos made from it, notes, captions (false = make them without captions; or {style} in words).

captions.description: override what was read: false = no captions, or a caption look in words

creator.description: a saved creator (list_creators) who stars in every video made from it

name.description: what to call it (default: a name read off the video)

notes.description: anything to keep in mind each time it is used

video.description: the video to save; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

name: save_video_preset
title: Save a video as a preset
